# /crav1-match-to-specs

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From existing repos and a dump to specs](../../from-match.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-match-to-specs/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Match one or more repos that already make up a system, plus a dump of notes, tickets, old docs, diagrams, or screenshots, to docs/system/ (including glossary.md) and one spec per confirmed slice.

## Runs when

Existing repos plus a dump. Called by the user.

This is one of the seven starter options. Asking for startup options names it and does not run it.

## Reads

In short: The repos and the dump.

Reads the repos and the dump.

## Writes

In short: Landscape gaps (including a missing glossary and new rows), one spec per confirmed slice, index rows, `docs/sources/` for an imported source, the transfer data policy after a yes, and `Used by` on a quoted note.

Writes `docs/system/` in the destination the user picks (gaps only when it exists, including a missing glossary and new rows) and one `docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md` per confirmed slice, including not in the code, then index rows. When a dump file it quotes is an imported source, also writes `docs/sources/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/`, following `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/sources.md`. That check may write the transfer data policy after a yes. Cursor: `.cursor/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.mdc`. Claude Code project: `.claude/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.md`. It never writes a secrets choice into that file. For a mail, it lists each embedded image, inline or attached. It recommends convert to text when the image is a diagram, a table, or text that can be reproduced exactly, and compress otherwise. It asks once before the source folder is written. Auto-accept applies to those recommendations only when the transfer data policy clearly covers them. A `repos.md` it writes includes a `Synced at` column and leaves that cell empty. It does not set or clear an existing cell.

## Does not

Leaves application code, `plan.md`, `work-item.md`, and the rest of an existing landscape alone. Does not commit.

Limits and exceptions: a slice that is not in the code stays thin and is not planned here. A quoted note in `docs/notes/` gets `Used by <slug>`. `Absorbed by <slug>` only after the user says yes, when this spec takes the whole note.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-feature-branch`](crav1-feature-branch.md) in that destination when it already has commits.

## Lane and group

Lane: Specify. Group: Start. Starter option: yes. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

## Stage and since

Stage: stable. Since: 1.0.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).

## First prompt

```text
/crav1-match-to-specs
@repo-a/
@repo-b/
@notes/old-spec.md
@tickets/

The repos are what exists. The dump is what to match.
Do not write code. Ask where the specs go, then map, and stop.
```
